ev.q: Of the 5,337 laboratory-confirmed cases of novel influenza A (H1N1) virus infection, 41.9% of patients were aged <15 years
55.7% of deaths occurred among those aged 30--59 years
of which 5,337 (21.2%) were positive for novel influenza A (H1N1) virus infection
Among patients with novel influenza A (H1N1) virus infection, 55.7% of deaths occurred among those aged 30--59 years
national surveillance identified 41,998 persons with acute respiratory illness
The Mexico Ministry of Health also initiated investigations of outbreaks throughout the country
Trends in case counts in Mexico suggest that novel influenza A (H1N1) activity is now decreasing
